query: Bally's plans to exceed the 10 percent renewable energy requirement through on-site solar and NYSERDA-qualified off-site procurement.

commitment.title: Proposed renewable energy plan for Bally's Bronx casino project
commitment.description: Bally's Bronx application materials describe a plan to ensure at least 10% of the facility’s annual electricity consumption comes from NYSERDA-qualified renewable energy sources, with part generated on-site and the remainder procured off-site. The on-site component is proposed as photovoltaic solar panels on the parking garage and select roof areas, projected to supply about 6% of annual energy consumption.
commitment.original_text: As the Gaming Facility’s design is finalized, the exact proportions of energy generated on-site versus energy procured will be further refined to ensure the target of at least 10 percent renewable energy consumption is met.
commitment.amount_value: at least 10 percent of annual electricity consumption from renewable energy; approximately 6 percent from on-site solar target
commitment.condition_contingency: As the Gaming Facility’s design is finalized, the exact proportions of on-site generation versus procured energy will be further refined.
commitment.notes: The cited materials describe a proposed plan in application documents, not completed delivery. Off-site renewable energy is described as NYSERDA-qualified procurement for the remainder needed to reach at least 10%.

findings.claim: Bally's application commits that the gaming facility will procure or generate on-site at least 10% of its annual electricity consumption from NYSERDA-qualified renewable energy sources; this plan was documented in application materials later posted as final by May 5, 2026.

supports.excerpt: As of May 5, 2026, the following Bally's records denoted with “REVISED REDACTIONS” suffixes have undergone the statutory review process, are considered final, and are posted below.
supports.summary: As of May 5, 2026, Bally's application records with “REVISED REDACTIONS” had completed statutory review, were considered final, and were posted by the New York casino licensing website.
supports.explanation: This establishes that the posted application materials were finalized records as of that date, helping date the documented plan.

supports.excerpt: A description of plans for procuring or generating on-site at least 10 percent of the facility’s annual electricity consumption from renewable energy sources qualified by the New York State Energy Research and Development Authority (NYSERDA).
supports.summary: Bally's application includes a plan to procure or generate on-site at least 10 percent of the facility’s annual electricity consumption from renewable energy sources qualified by NYSERDA.
supports.explanation: This sentence states the undertaking’s core obligation and scope: at least 10% of the facility’s annual electricity use is to come from NYSERDA-qualified renewable sources, whether procured or generated on-site.

findings.claim: Bally's states that the remaining renewable electricity needed beyond on-site generation to reach at least 10% of annual electricity consumption will be procured from NYSERDA-qualified renewable energy sources, including NYSERDA Tier IV NYC-centric renewable energy.

supports.excerpt: In addition to on-site generation, the remainder of the renewable energy needed to meet at least 10 percent of the facility’s annual electricity consumption will be procured from renewable energy sources qualified by the New York State Energy Research and Development Authority (NYSERDA).
supports.summary: Bally's says that, beyond on-site generation, the remainder needed to reach at least 10 percent of annual electricity consumption will be procured from NYSERDA-qualified renewable energy sources.
supports.explanation: This passage directly supports the off-site procurement component needed to reach the 10% renewable electricity target.

supports.excerpt: Bronx Bally’s will also embrace NYSERDA Tier IV NYC centric renewable energy with the goal to increase the penetration of renewable energy in New York City through eligible resources located in NYC or delivered through a new transmission interconnection to NYC.
supports.summary: Bally's also says Bronx Bally’s will embrace NYSERDA Tier IV NYC-centric renewable energy, aiming to increase renewable penetration in New York City through eligible resources located in NYC or delivered through a new transmission interconnection to NYC.
supports.explanation: This provides additional context on the type of NYSERDA-qualified off-site renewable energy Bally's says it will use, but it does not by itself restate the 10% obligation.

findings.claim: For the on-site portion of the renewable electricity plan, Bally's proposes photovoltaic solar panels across the parking garage and select roof areas totaling about 46,000 square feet, projected to produce about 1.8 million kWh of carbon-free electricity per year and supply about 6% of annual energy consumption.

supports.excerpt: To reduce electrical demand and comply with New York City local laws, the resort plans to install photovoltaic (PV) solar panels across the parking garage and select roof areas in accordance with NYC Local Laws 92 and 94. Approximately 46,000-sq. ft. will be utilized for photovoltaic panels and associated inverters. These areas are predicted to produce approximately 1.8 million kWh of carbon free electricity per year.
supports.summary: For the on-site portion, the resort plans to install photovoltaic solar panels across the parking garage and select roof areas, using about 46,000 square feet and predicting production of about 1.8 million kWh of carbon-free electricity per year.
supports.explanation: This text gives the proposed on-site implementation method, physical scope, and forecast output for the solar component.

supports.excerpt: The target is approximately 6% of the annual energy consumption.
supports.summary: The on-site solar component is targeted to supply approximately 6% of annual energy consumption.
supports.explanation: This specifies the planned contribution of the on-site solar portion toward the broader renewable-energy target.

findings.claim: Bally's says that as the gaming facility design is finalized, the exact proportions between on-site generation and procured renewable energy will be further refined while still ensuring at least 10% renewable energy consumption is met.

supports.excerpt: As the Gaming Facility’s design is finalized, the exact proportions of energy generated on-site versus energy procured will be further refined to ensure the target of at least 10 percent renewable energy consumption is met.
supports.summary: Bally's states that as the gaming facility design is finalized, the exact proportions between on-site generation and procured energy will be further refined to ensure at least 10 percent renewable energy consumption is met.
supports.explanation: This passage qualifies the commitment by noting the split between on-site and procured renewable energy was not final and could change while still aiming to meet the 10% target.

findings.claim: Bally’s renewable-energy commitment in its Application, including the plan to meet at least 10% through on-site solar and NYSERDA-qualified procurement, is subject to ongoing third-party compliance monitoring and reporting to the Commission.

supports.excerpt: Bally’s shall contract promptly with and compensate appropriately an independent third-party CMT firm, proposed by Bally’s and approved by the Commission, to monitor and report to the Commission, with notice to the board of directors of Bally’s, as frequently as the Commission may request, on the ongoing compliance of Bally’s with each of the elements of the Application and the regulatory obligations of Bally’s

findings.claim: Bally’s must publicly report progress and explain delays in delivering Application benefits and commitments, which would include the renewable-energy undertaking if treated as one of those commitments.

supports.excerpt: Each such report shall detail progress, set forth relevant budget and expenditure, and explain actual or anticipated delays in delivery of benefits proposed in the Application or Bally’s other commitments.

unmatched_records.excerpt: Use of Renewable Energy Credits (RECs): To offset any residual emissions, Bally’s will purchase RECs in accordance with LL97 guidelines.

Four applicants - Bally's Bronx, Hard Rock Metropolitan Park, MGM Yonkers, and Resorts World New York City - received Community Advisory Committee approval, establishing public support for these projects. The other four applicants failed to achieve the required two-thirds approval threshold and were eliminated from further consideration.
On-Site Solar Generation: Rooftop and canopy-mounted photovoltaic (PV) systems will be installed to generate clean electricity, with battery storage to manage peak loads and provide backup power.
